## Company Financial Data

**Source**: SEC EDGAR CompanyFacts API  
**Raw data**: [`company_financials_raw.csv`](../data/raw/company_financials_raw.csv)  
**Clean data**: [`company_financials_clean.csv`](../data/clean/company_financials_clean.csv)  

The dataset includes 40 publicly traded companies across 8 sectors, with key financial metrics for the most recent fiscal year (10-K filing). Derived metrics include ROA, ROE, debt-to-equity, and profit margin.

```{r}
#| label: load-financials
#| echo: true
library(readr)
fin <- read_csv("../data/clean/company_financials_clean.csv")
head(fin)
```
